scripts.lhci:desktop: pnpm run preview:start && (npx lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.json; code=$?; pnpm run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.lhci:mobile: pnpm run preview:start && (npx lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.mobile.json; code=$?; pnpm run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm run preview:start && (npx playwright test tests/a11y.spec.ts; code=$?; pnpm run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run preview:start && (npx playwright test tests/e2e; code=$?; pnpm run preview:stop; exit $code)
